```python
def slug(text):
    import re
    # Convert to lowercase and replace runs of non-alphanumeric with a hyphen
    cleaned = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]', '-', text.lower())
    # Strip edge hyphens
    return cleaned.strip('-')
```
